title: Ronga 2021 adult near/far ERP
citation: Ronga, I., Galigani, M., Bruno, V., Noel, J.-P., Gazzin, A., Perathoner, C., Serino, A., & Garbarini, F. (2021). Spatial tuning of electrophysiological responses to multisensory stimuli reveals a primitive coding of the body boundaries in newborns. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, 118(12), e2024548118.
notes: Inspection of the five conditions and published trigger-relative timing for passive EEG. Launch requires calibrated electrocutaneous delivery, physical near/far loudspeakers and synchronized EEG.

study_inventory.scope: Newborn and adult ERP cohorts have separate schedules within one comparative study.

cohort.handedness: Right-handed according to the Edinburgh Handedness Inventory.

auditory_stimulus.signal: Stationary Audacity-generated amplitude-modulated sinusoid from one of two physical loudspeakers.

trial_schedule.trigger: Common E-Prime–Arduino trigger used as zero for all five EEG conditions.
trial_schedule.order: Intermix all five conditions with equal trial counts and no more than two identical trials consecutively.

eeg.layout: 32 Ag/AgCl 10–20 electrodes, nose online reference, right-side EOG.

analysis.primary: Within each cohort, compare near vs far and paired ERP vs the algebraic sum of corresponding tactile-only and auditory-only ERPs. Quantify mean P2 amplitude and peak latency.
analysis.gfp: Find an adult global field power window with p < .01 for at least ten consecutive samples. The union boundaries for near and far differences define 222–338 ms.

auxiliary_procedures.label: Adult tactile threshold
auxiliary_procedures.scope: Method of limits prior to the EEG session. Use twice each measured perceptual threshold in the main task.

auxiliary_procedures.label: Adult simultaneity check
auxiliary_procedures.scope: Adults in the pilot reported perceived simultaneity when sound followed tactile onset by 40 ms.

auxiliary_procedures.label: Adult handedness eligibility
auxiliary_procedures.scope: The Edinburgh Handedness Inventory established right-handed eligibility. All 25 adults were reported right-handed.

reference_parameters.preview_scope: The source-defined schedule is available for inspection. No acoustic substitution, electronic stimulation or behavioral detection response is supplied.
implementation_gaps: The original tone file, modulation depth, delivered acoustic calibration and exact physical coordinates are unavailable.

The scheduler must share a trigger between near/far audio and the electrocutaneous pulse, preserve the 40 ms auditory delay in all four audio-present conditions and intermix the five passive condition rows.
Recording and analysis require calibrated physical stimulus delivery, compatible EEG acquisition and EEG event response processing. Author trial-order and delivered-timing files are unavailable.
